description: Laura Piho and Asko Ristolainen deposited Hydromast measurements from three stations along the northern channel connecting Lake Varna with the Black Sea. The public dataset covers 18 February to 18 May 2025 and contains one-minute averages of water-flow velocity, flow direction and water level derived from pressure. Three station CSV files and a PDF manual are listed in the TalTech Data Repository. These observations describe conditions in a working port channel and provide measurements for hydraulic simulation and model checking. Quality filters replace rejected or missing observations with NaN. The sensors measure velocities between 0.06 and 0.6 metres per second; observations outside that range were removed. Original 50 Hz measurements are available on request and are not the public one-minute series. Public files are freely accessible under CC BY 4.0. Station 3's listed filename begins on 6 March 2025, so station coverage differs. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed.
